title: 第三章 反休第四章 有客至
lines: 手里握着狼毫，笔尖沾着朱砂，还没写完一张平安符的王贤。
闻言一愣：“师父，我只有你和师姐，哪来的婚约？”
老道士闻言，眼珠转了转。
脸上的神情变了再变，突然想起一事。
看着王贤嘿嘿一笑：“乖徒儿，倘若你以后遇到一个恶婆娘要休你，怎么办？”
王贤“哦！”了一声。
看着手里的狼毫，想都不想问了一句：“弟子不知，换成师父会怎样？”
老道士呵呵一笑：“换成是为师，自然是休了她！”
王贤听了师父所言，取了一张黄纸，挥笔如剑，在上面写下了个大大的“休”字！
递给面前目瞪口呆的老道士：“师父，这是你要的字！”
老道士一见，麻了。
眼睛眨了眨，脸上露出一抹古怪的微笑。
嘿嘿笑了笑：“这还不够，你得咬破手指，滴血在这‘休’字上面，才有法力！”
“哦，那会好痛啊！”
王贤心里抗拒，却无法拒绝眼前的师父，只好咬破手指......
只见一滴金色的血液缓缓落下沿着人字偏旁，往下渗去。
“哈哈！如此甚好！”
老道士自王贤手中接过染血的黄纸，伸向供桌上的香烛上点燃。
捏着一张燃烧的符文，走出大殿外，仰天大声如宣旨一般。
“恶已；皆知善之为善，斯不善已！”
“嗖！”的一声。
老道士手中燃烧的符文如一道闪电，又似一刺破天穹的剑光，往天际刹那斩去。
拉着走出大殿的王贤，冷冷地喝道。
记住：“你是我金无量的徒儿，普天之下，没有人可以欺负你！”
王贤歪着脑袋沉思半晌，竟然想不到一句回应的话。
只好说道：“师父威武！”
呜呜！
漫天的寒风呼啸！
就在司马玄天，端木云潜带着各自的夫人，儿女欲下凤凰台，去准备订婚宴席的刹那！
有一道，二道，三道闪电往天际而来。
只是电光石火之间，便有几道闪电骤然落下，轰在凤凰台下的广场之上。
原本闻听执法长老向天宣告端木曦休书一事，书院便有无数的长老，弟子走出门来。
content_en:
Wang Xian holds a wolf hair in his hand and the tip of his pen is stained with cinnabar. He has not yet finished writing a peace talisman.
Hearing this, he was stunned: "Master, I only have you and my senior sister, where did the engagement come from?"
The old Taoist priest rolled his eyes when he heard this.
The expression on his face changed again and again, and he suddenly remembered something.
Looking at Wang Xian, he chuckled: "My good disciple, what if you meet an evil woman who wants to divorce you in the future?"
Wang Xian said "Oh!"
Looking at the wolf hair in his hand, he asked without thinking: "I don't know, disciple, what would happen if I were the master?"
The old Taoist priest chuckled: "If she were a teacher, of course I would divorce her!"
Wang Xian listened to what his master said, took a piece of yellow paper, waved his pen like a sword, and wrote a big "Hugh" on it!
He handed it to the stunned old Taoist priest in front of him: "Master, this is the word you want!"
The old Taoist priest felt numb when he saw it.
His eyes blinked, and a strange smile appeared on his face.
Hehe smiled: "That's not enough, you have to bite your finger and drip blood on the word 'Hugh' to gain magical power!"
"Oh, that's going to hurt so much!"
Wang Xian resisted in his heart, but could not refuse the master in front of him, so he had to bite his finger...
I saw a drop of golden blood slowly falling down along the side of the herringbone and seeping down.
"Haha! So good!"
The old Taoist priest took the blood-stained yellow paper from Wang Xian's hand, stretched it to the incense candle on the altar table, and lit it.
Holding a burning rune in his hand, he walked out of the hall and raised his head to the sky, shouting like a decree.
"It's evil; everyone knows that good is good, but this is not good!"
"Whoosh!"
The burning runes in the hands of the old Taoist priest were like a bolt of lightning, or like a sword light piercing the sky, slashing towards the sky in an instant.
Wang Xian, who was pulling him out of the hall, shouted coldly.
Remember: "You are my golden disciple, no one in the world can bully you!"
Wang Xian tilted his head and thought for a long time, but he couldn't think of a word to respond.
He could only say: "Master is mighty!"
...
Woohoo!
The cold wind howls in the sky!
At the moment when Sima Xuantian, Duanmu Yunqian and their respective wives and children were about to leave the Phoenix Terrace to prepare for the engagement banquet!
There were one, two, and three lightning bolts coming towards the sky.
In just a flash of lightning, several bolts of lightning suddenly fell and struck the square below the Phoenix Tower.
After hearing the law enforcement elder announcing to the sky that Duanmu Xi had given up his studies, countless elders and disciples came out of the academy.
title_en: Chapter 3: Anti-break Chapter 4: Guests are coming
